content:
Alex: Morning all — quick async daybook. What I did: triaged the EU embed latency alerts, adjusted autoscaler min replicas for batcher-2.
Maria: Nice. Any residual signal after the config change?
Alex: Reduced spike count by ~70% in the last hour. Still seeing 1-2 p95 blips tied to cache misses.
Chen: Cache misses = KV eviction maybe? Which pool?
Alex: batcher-2 / eu-west-2. I saw eviction events around 03:12 UTC. Link to logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/tx/8f3b
Sam: I pushed a small KV warmup patch (PR 8421) — still needs review from @Maria and @Ravi.
Maria: On it, will review after standup. Heads-up: PR touches the warmup loop, quick perf test looks fine.
Ravi: If it passes, we should canary deploy to one node before global.
Emily: Blockers: I hit a flaky test in autoscaler e2e; reproducing locally now. Might stall the rollout if it keeps failing.
Sam: Which test? Name/trace?
Emily: `autoscale_test.TestStableRamp` — flakes with timing on slower CI runners. Repro steps in PR notes.
Chen: Suggest adding a small tolerance/timeout in the test rather than full rewrite. We had similar in 2024.
oncall-bot: [incident] SLO alert: embed_latency_p95 breached for EU region — 7165429980 — assigned to Alex
Alex: Took ownership, investigating (see above). Will keep duty loop updated.
Maria: Ops note: reminder to follow runbook if we hit >5% error rate for 15m. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/sre/runbooks/slo-ops
Ravi: Today's plan for me — finish autoscaler canary matrix, patch the rollout script for graceful drain. ETA 4h.
Sam: FYI I've nudged @Maria on PR 8421, left a small comment about backoff in warmup.
Maria: Saw it, replied. If backoff is safe, lgtm after CI.
Alex: Quick check — any alerts I should escalate beyond EU embed latency?
Chen: No other active SLO alerts. A handful of 5xx spikes in internal reranker but below thresholds.
Emily: Oncall follow-ups: remind next shift to rotate the warmup job earlier during nights (notes in handover doc).
Sam: Add a ping to the rotation calendar? I can add a recurring block.
Ravi: Please do. Also adding a short checklist to the runbook: warmup cadence, canary steps, rollback tags.
Alex: Blocker for me: we need approval to bump batcher-2 min replicas in prod for the sustained load pattern — product asked for cost analysis.
Maria: I'll draft a quick delta-cost calc, pinging finance for numbers.
Chen: For the short term, can we set a temporary override for 6h and monitor?
Ravi: +1 for temporary override, with explicit rollback condition (p95 < target for 30m).
Alex: OK I'll open a short-lived override (tag: eu-batcher-override-716543).
oncall-bot: [deploy] Canary deploy started for PR 8421 to node eu-batcher-2-canary — 7165431500
Sam: Thanks — will watch metrics.
Maria: Review note: add a small comment in PR explaining why we don't want full parallel warmups (cost).
Sam: Will add.
Emily: Sync ask: can the person on the next midday shift double-check `kv_evictions` graph between 02:30-04:00 UTC and paste a screenshot? Helps root cause.
Alex: I can grab that before handoff.
Chen: Small housekeeping — code review queue items: 8430, 8432, 8421 (Sam). If you own one, drop a quick "taking" reply so others know.
Sam: Taking 8421 and 8432.
Maria: Taking 8430.
Ravi: Anything else?
Alex: Nope — will post a short follow-up after the canary metrics stabilize. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Maria: Thanks — will post cost delta and ETA for finance reply.
Chen: Thanks, signing off.
oncall-bot: [notice] Handoff reminder: next shift @Rina starts in 2h — please update handover doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/sre/handoffs/daybook-716543
Alex: Will update with the latest logs and the temporary override note.
Emily: End-of-thread check: anyone planning changes to alert thresholds today?
Ravi: I might tweak debounce from 3m to 4m for the embedders during the canary window only. I'll post the change and rationale.
Alex: Sounds good. If the tweak is temporary, include explicit expiry.
Maria: Ok that's all from me.
Sam: LGTM, monitoring.
Alex: closing the loop — last_message: 7165432185
